recognize_zh: CD30染色中大型腫瘤細胞一致性呈強烈膜狀加核旁點狀（Golgi）陽性，成群呈黏著性團塊或巢狀分布於陰性小細胞之間，這種「成片、強度一致」的CD30是ALCL的必要特徵。
features: Strong, uniform membranous and paranuclear Golgi-type CD30 staining in large cells
Positive cells form cohesive clusters, nests and sheets, some with a sinusoidal-like distribution
Large cells with abundant cytoplasm and vesicular nuclei
Intervening negative small lymphocytes and stromal cells
describe_en: CD30 immunostain shows strong and uniform membranous and Golgi-zone staining in virtually all large neoplastic cells, which grow in cohesive clusters, nests and sheets separated by negative small lymphocytes and stroma. The intensity is homogeneous across the large-cell population. This pattern is characteristic of anaplastic large cell lymphoma; with negative ALK it supports ALK-negative ALCL.

ddx.vs: cHL shows CD30 in scattered HRS cells (except syncytial variant) with CD15 and weak PAX5, rather than uniform sheets of CD30+ T cells.
CD30 in PTCL NOS is variable in intensity and proportion, while ALCL shows strong uniform CD30 in nearly all tumor cells.
Embryonal carcinoma is CD30-positive but also keratin, SALL4 and OCT3/4-positive and CD45/T-cell-marker negative.
BIA-ALCL shares the CD30+ ALK- phenotype but arises in periprosthetic effusion or capsule, a clinical rather than morphologic distinction.
